Say his name. Kevin Peterson, Jr. Beautiful life lost. We don’t have to live like this. #BlackLivesMatter 
#KevinPetersonJr

There’s a community vigil in memory of Kevin Peterson, Jr. tonight. Come bring honor to his memory. Wear a mask and practice social distancing. #KevinPeterson #Vancouver #BlackLivesMatter #SayHisName https://t.co/zO8QQYnA03

Unreal that we live in a world where a vigil for the police shooting of a Black man, Kevin Peterson, Jr., is protested by armed Trump supporters. What are they protesting? Grief? The right of police to shoot whomever they choose? Despicable. #BlackLivesMatter #KevinPetersonJr

Georgians voted for Ahmaud Arbery, who could not vote due to racists taking his life. Philadelphians voted for Walter Wallace, who could not vote due to racist police taking his life. We all voted for Breonna Taylor, for George Floyd, for Kevin Peterson, Jr. #BlackLivesMatter

Kevin Peterson, Jr. was killed over a sting to buy Xanax. The police set up a sting and then murdered him because he was selling a prescription drug. It did not have to play out like this. He did not fire at officers. Witnesses confirm this. His life mattered. #BlackLivesMatter

Tamir Rice should be alive today. He should’ve attended prom, graduated high school, had his first kiss. Six years ago today he was murdered for playing w a toy gun in a park by an armed agent of the state. Don’t call the police on children. Or on Black people. #BlackLivesMatter

Truly heartbreaking. Gun violence disproportionately impacts young Black men. Travis overcame so much to be a leader in the #BlackLivesMatter movement and his potential & joyful presence is lost. Tragic.

Louisville protests leader, Travis Nagdy, killed. https://t.co/JtiDO1bUID

I am horrified, angry, and upset. This seems targeted. We need to speak out and make sure we protect Black leaders. #BlackLivesMatter

Kris Smith Is the Second Louisville Protest Leader to Be Murdered in Three Weeks https://t.co/gSZxORBEx9

This is heartbreaking to read. The shooting of Kevin Peterson, Jr., as told by his girlfriend, who was on the phone with him, @liviiaselto. Kevin says he was set up. And he’s terrified. It didn’t have to be this way. #BlackLivesMatter #KevinPetersonJr

We all saw the video. We all saw officers were not in immediate danger & did not need to shoot & paralyze Jacob Blake. When will Black Lives Matter more than police fear? #BlackLivesMatter

No charges filed against Kenosha officers in Jacob Blake shooting https://t.co/7Um0tiz7GX
